column1: # Signal catalog for scan.sh. Tab-separated: id, category, since, scope, ERE pattern, note.
# category: removed (breaks compile/run from <since>), deprecated (warns from <since>), behavior (semantics change at <since>),
#           flag (JVM/build flag obsolete or erroring from <since>), build (build-blocker library: check min version for target),
#           modernize (newer idiom final since <since>). scope: java (*.java), build (pom.xml, *.gradle*, .mvn/*), config (scripts, Dockerfiles, CI, *.properties, *.conf, *.yml).
# Range rule (scan.sh --from F --to T): removed/deprecated/behavior when F < since <= T; flag/build/modernize when since <= T.
# Patterns are POSIX ERE without \b or \s so rg and grep -E agree.

column6: JEP 320: JAXB removed from JDK. Add jakarta.xml.bind-api + org.glassfish.jaxb:jaxb-runtime (or javax.xml.bind:jaxb-api 2.3.x to keep javax namespace)
JEP 320: JAX-WS/SAAJ removed. Add jakarta.xml.ws-api + com.sun.xml.ws:jaxws-rt
JEP 320: JAF removed. Add jakarta.activation-api
JEP 320: common annotations removed. Add jakarta.annotation-api (javax.annotation.processing stays in JDK)
JEP 320: JTA classes removed (javax.transaction.xa stays). Add jakarta.transaction-api
JEP 320: CORBA removed, no JDK replacement. Use glassfish-corba or drop CORBA
JavaFX unbundled from Oracle JDK 11. Add org.openjfx dependencies + javafx-maven-plugin/javafx-gradle-plugin
Removed in 9. Use java.util.Base64
JDK internal API: not visible with --release 9+, reflective access denied from 17 (JEP 403). Run jdeps --jdk-internals for replacements
JEP 220: rt.jar/tools.jar gone. Use jdk.compiler module APIs (javax.tools) or jrt:/ filesystem
Old doclet API removed in 13. Port to jdk.javadoc.doclet
JEP 223: version is "9", "17.0.2", no "1.x" prefix. Use Runtime.version().feature()
JEP 372: Nashorn removed. Add org.openjdk.nashorn:nashorn-core 15.x (needs 11+) or move to GraalJS
JEP 367: Pack200 removed. Use plain jar/zip compression
JEP 407: RMI Activation removed. Plain RMI still works
JEP 403 (17): reflection into JDK internals throws InaccessibleObjectException; needs --add-opens. JEP 500 (26): mutating final fields via reflection warns
JEP 390: wrapper constructors deprecated for removal. Use valueOf / autoboxing
JEP 421: finalization deprecated for removal. Use try-with-resources (AutoCloseable) or java.lang.ref.Cleaner; test with --finalization=disabled
JEP 400: default charset is UTF-8 everywhere. Behavior changes on non-UTF-8 hosts (Windows). Pass an explicit charset; keep existing StandardCharsets.UTF_8
JEP 431: new getFirst/getLast/reversed/addFirst/addLast/removeFirst/removeLast on List/Deque/Sorted*. Custom subclasses with same-named methods but different return types fail to compile
JEP 451: dynamic agent loading warns (future: denied). Attach Mockito as -javaagent in surefire/test task (see java-build references)
JEP 486: Security Manager permanently disabled; setSecurityManager throws, -Djava.security.manager fails startup. Delete the code paths
JEP 472: JNI use warns. Add --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED (or Enable-Native-Access manifest attribute); consider FFM API (final 22)
JEP 471 (23) deprecated memory-access methods, JEP 498 (24) warns at runtime. Use VarHandle (on-heap) or FFM MemorySegment (off-heap)
String Templates (JEP 430/459, preview 21-22) withdrawn and removed in 23. Rewrite with + , String.format / formatted, or StringBuilder
JEP 505 (25) replaced the API with StructuredTaskScope.open(Joiner); still preview through 27 (JEP 533 changed it again). Avoid unless user opts into preview
JEP 504: Applet API removed in 26. Convert to standalone Swing app or drop
JEP 363: CMS removed in 14. Use G1 (default) or ZGC
JEP 158/271: unified logging. Replace with -Xlog:gc*:file=gc.log:time,uptime:filecount=5,filesize=10m; several old flags make JVM refuse to start
PermGen gone since 8; use MaxMetaspaceSize only if needed
Obsolete/expired flags: JVM refuses to start on newer JDKs. Remove
JEP 374: biased locking removed; flag obsolete since 18. Remove
JEP 403: --illegal-access ignored since 17. Replace with targeted --add-opens module/package=ALL-UNNAMED
JEP 490: non-generational ZGC removed in 24; ZGenerational obsolete. Keep only -XX:+UseZGC
Preview features are tied to one exact JDK release. On every JDK bump re-check each preview API (jdk-matrix.md); drop the flag when nothing preview remains
Lombok must know the target JDK: >=1.18.30 for 21, >=1.18.40 for 25, >=1.18.46 for 26, >=1.18.48 for 27. Annotation processing needs explicit processor path on 23+
Annotation processor: on 23+ javac no longer runs processors implicitly; configure annotationProcessorPaths / annotationProcessor or -proc:full
JaCoCo must read target class files: >=0.8.11 for 21, >=0.8.14 for 25, >=0.8.15 for 26, >=0.8.16 for 27
Byte Buddy needs a release that knows the class-file version (1.18.x for 25-27); -Dnet.bytebuddy.experimental=true as stopgap
Error Prone >=2.43 needs JDK 21 to run; >=2.46 also needs -XDaddTypeAnnotationsToSymbol=true on 21
Kotlin compiler caps the JVM target: Kotlin 2.3+ needed for Java 25 target
AspectJ weaver must support target class files (1.9.21+ for 21, latest 1.9.2x for 25+)
Records (JEP 395) candidate if the class is a shallowly immutable value. Not for JPA entities, mutable beans, or classes with inheritance
Pattern matching for instanceof (JEP 394): bind the variable instead of casting
Switch expressions / arrow labels (JEP 361); type patterns in switch from 21 (JEP 441)
Text block (JEP 378) candidate for SQL/JSON/HTML built from concatenated lines
Stream.toList() (16) returns an unmodifiable list; keep Collectors.toList() if callers mutate the result
List/Set/Map.of / copyOf (9/10) for constant data. They reject nulls and are not views
SequencedCollection.getLast() (JEP 431)
Virtual threads (JEP 444) for blocking I/O tasks: Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor(). Not for CPU-bound work; do not pool virtual threads
ScopedValue (JEP 506, final 25) when the value is bound once per call scope and never mutated
String.isBlank() (11); note strip() is Unicode-aware, trim() is not
Files.readString / writeString (11)
java.net.http.HttpClient (11) for new code; migrate when touching the call
java.time (JSR 310). Convert at API boundaries; SimpleDateFormat is not thread-safe
